selection.draw_rule: Draw the remaining 11 signs with rng.choice([-1,1], size=11), independently and uniformly; candidate indices are one-based.
selection.acceptance: Accept first five distinct candidates satisfying only sign-count and covariance-change constraints; no prediction or metric selection. Global sign equivalence fixed by s[0]=+1.

noise.source: Existing byte-verified Standard 0-dB float32 base arrays; never generate new electrode sources.
noise.signed_operation: Multiply Standard base noise by the frozen lead signs, then apply the same float32 10**(-snr/20) factor used by E and add the unchanged clean float32 input.
noise.independent: Existing same-record same-seed Standard independent_rms base; no replacement comparator.
noise.persistence: Reference existing base files; stream and hash every final input and record. Do not duplicate raw waveforms or materialize redundant signed bases/noisy datasets.

statistics.aggregation: Paired metric differences within each common patient draw, checkpoint, noise seed and signed mode; equal mean across five modes and six noises within checkpoint, then across three training seeds. Never average probabilities.
statistics.seed_sd: Sample SD, ddof=1, of the three within-training-seed mean effects.
statistics.noise_sd: Sample SD across six fixed noise effects after averaging training seeds and signed modes; descriptive only.
statistics.signed_mode_sd: Sample SD across five fixed mode effects after averaging noises and training seeds; descriptive only, not additional training repetitions.
statistics.patient_ci: Shared frozen patient-cluster draws, all ECGs of each sampled patient; 2.5/97.5 percentiles conditional on these checkpoints, noises and controls, not joint uncertainty.
statistics.invalid_draws: Preserve NaN AUROC draws missing a class, never redraw; ordinary means propagate invalidity; report invalid counts.
statistics.f1: Original frozen clean-validation thresholds; comparison >=; zero_division=0.
statistics.ece: Original macro classwise positive-probability ECE with 15 equal-width bins; positive ECE contrast is worse, positive AUROC/F1 contrast is better.
statistics.inference: Exploratory descriptive mechanism analysis; no new p-values, Holm families, equivalence claims, clinical dominance or unique-cause claims.

subspace.q: ||Q v||_F^2 / ||v||_F^2 in float64; null and explicitly counted if denominator is zero.
subspace.noise_definition: Audit both designed scaled float32 noise and actual float64(noisy_float32)-float64(clean_float32); primary q_noise uses actual injected residual.
subspace.shift_policy: Reuse only existing directly verifiable circular-shift input arrays if present; otherwise report not newly generated, without inventing an equivalent branch.

execution.reuse_policy: Reuse E/I and clean only after exact cohort, input, checkpoint, thresholds, model-source, probability-hash and frozen-metric checks. Workers own separate predictions, ledgers and reports.

gates.periodogram_error_definition: Check every frequency bin separately for every lead. Designed signed-noise PSDs must be exactly equal. Post-addition residual PSD error is the maximum absolute bin difference divided by the reference peak for that lead, not a pooled lead spectrum. Zero reference spectra require exact zero.

prohibitions: raw PTB-XL waveform upload or copying
mutation of phase1, phase2, or methodology_supplement scientific results
